name: ks-display-name-rule
what: The display-name rule for an AGENT and a SESSION (the C04 identifier rule of name-rule-v1.json still holds for a project and a key alias). A name is what a person reads and types, so it may carry single spaces: ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, underscores and single spaces between them, starting with a letter. The service trims leading and trailing spaces and collapses a run of spaces to one before it judges and stores a name; an agent's name is at most 48 characters and a session's at most 64, counted after that. The name is never an identifier: records are named by their ids, and where a word must be typed on its own (an @ mention) the console uses a slug, the name with each space written as a hyphen. The service's rule is checked against these cases by ctl's tests; the client vendors this file and holds every name it sends to the same cases.
